scope: Public real-time or near-real-time dissolved-oxygen observations relevant to Mobile Bay Jubilee research
conclusion: ARCOS is the primary public continuous DO network for Mobile Bay; Weeks Bay NERRS adds Fish River/Weeks Bay water-quality context. No additional independent current Mobile-Bay DO network with comparable public machine-readable coverage was verified in this pass.

primary_sources.access: Public Grafana PostgreSQL datasource via g.disl.edu; no credentials required
primary_sources.cadence: Dashboard aggregates/display uses 30-minute intervals; ARCOS map suppresses stations older than 30 minutes
primary_sources.qc: DISL publishes physical range criteria and aggregate flag definitions; current public Grafana frames do not expose aggregate QC flag per returned row, so collector applies range/freshness screens and retains SOURCE_QC_NOT_EXPOSED

stations.name: Dauphin Island
stations.model_role: bay-mouth context; stale values must be UNKNOWN current

stations.name: Bon Secour
stations.model_role: P1 southeast-bay oxygen-loading context when hydro resumes

stations.name: Gulf State Park Pier
stations.model_role: coastal context if hydro becomes available

primary_sources.station: WKQA1 Fish River, Weeks Bay Reserve
primary_sources.access: NDBC realtime2 ocean feed; existing canonical collector
primary_sources.cadence: NERRS monitoring data nominally updated every 10 minutes
primary_sources.model_role: regional Weeks Bay/Fish River proxy, not Point Clear/Montrose bottom water

secondary_or_rejected.source: IOOS/GCOOS ERDDAP mirror of DISL stations
secondary_or_rejected.reason: Useful for metadata/QARTOD cross-checks but Meaher mirror was stale relative to live ARCOS during this audit; do not make it the primary freshness source.
Useful transport/model context, not a DO sensor observation.
Useful calibration/antecedent evidence but not regular real-time Mobile Bay DO for this ingest layer.

meaher_dawn_corroboration.independent_live_series_check: The public ARCOS two-day series returned matching 0.23 mg/L and 3.10% values in the recent sequence, corroborating the report as source data rather than a social-only observation.
meaher_dawn_corroboration.production_interpretation: Strong upper-bay oxygen-loading observation; not direct Point Clear shoreline bottom DO and not automatically a Jubilee label.

implementation.polling: twice hourly at minute 05 and 35 during canonical May 18-November 14 season
implementation.current_state: Fresh range-screened station observations admitted as zero-weight oxygen context; >60 minute station values become UNKNOWN_STALE
